principle: Never block indefinitely in a write path callable from critical threads; bound waits or signal the writer thread.
quote: this could block forever. ... At the very least we should limit this to 10ms, but it would be better to signal the thread that normally does the writes to wake up

principle: Code called from multiple threads needs a real mutex; a flag check is not sufficient.
quote: as this is called from 2 threads, I think this needs a mutex ... the in_timer check is not sufficient

principle: New code must be built in CI by at least one board.
quote: it doesn't look like this is built in CI, we need at least one CI board using this

principle: Features dealing with delays need a SITL simulation parameter (e.g. SIM_BARO_DELAY) so they can be tested.
quote: it would be nice to have a SIM_BARO_DELAY (or similar) parameter

principle: PR descriptions' testing claims must match what was actually tested.
quote: can you confirm it's actually tested on real copter? (tick box vs text mismatch)

principle: Restrict state-resetting actions to disarmed unless there is a use case in flight.
quote: maybe make this only allowed when disarmed? is there any use case for doing this when armed?

principle: Do not fabricate a measurement such as zero velocity on a flag that can be true while moving (smooth conveyor, ship).
quote: onGroundNotMoving would be true if we were on a very smooth conveyor belt or ship ... fusing zero velocity would not be good!

principle: Behaviour changes must be shown not to affect setups with other aiding sensors such as GPS.
quote: I didn't see why the changes only applied in a non-GPS ... setup

principle: Put infrequently changing data in a new log message to save log space and keep existing replay logs working.
quote: it would save a lot of log space and also mean that existing replay logs keep working by making this a new RISJ message

principle: Check driver constants against the datasheets of all supported chip variants.
quote: have you checked these numbers against all v3 variants datasheets? we support quite a few of them

principle: An autotest needs the SITL model/parameters that make the tested condition occur.
quote: I think we need SIM_BARO_GEFF parameters to control the simulated ground effect. How does this test work without that?

principle: When replacing a parameter, confirm board defaults keep equivalent meaning (disabled stays disabled).
quote: are they equivalent? old was disable, new means enabled, no gate?

principle: Changes in shared code must be checked for significant behaviour changes on other vehicles, especially Plane.
quote: this looks like a significant behaviour change on plane, ... which breaks important functionality

principle: Special-case inputs outside the domain of math functions such as log10f(0).
quote: log10f(0) gives a FPE ? I think we need a special case for power 0?

principle: In-flight state flags are unreliable: consider real operational procedures (VTOL takeoff mission while already flying) before gating fusion on them.
quote: this may break planes where users trigger a VTOL_TAKEOFF in a mission when already flying

principle: Maintainers are wary of proliferating option bits.
quote: Peter and Randy expressed some concerns about proliferation of options though

principle: Gate a hardware-specific fix behind a define defaulting to the old behaviour so other boards produce identical binaries and need no retesting.
quote: if we use HAL_CAN_ALLOW_INEXACT_CLOCK then we should get identical binaries on everything but L4 with LSE

principle: Do not modify shared code paths for hardware that does not use them, to avoid extra testing.
quote: L4 doesn't use the CANFD backend, so I'd prefer not to change it, or we'll need to do a bunch of testing

principle: Sensor processing that assumes the sensor is not rotating between readings is unusable on a moving vehicle or during calibration.
quote: it really does look like it assumes no rotation between Hn and Hn-1. When calibrating (or flying!) that just isn't true.

principle: First use of a std:: function needs analysis of what it compiles to on each MCU, as some platforms silently stub them.
quote: this is first use of these std:: functions, I'd like to see someone analyse what these actually do on our various MCUs

principle: Use microsecond timestamps for timing-sensitive extrapolation; millis adds noise.
quote: make sure you use micros, millis will add more noise

principle: Verify that a change does what the PR title claims and not the opposite in some conditions.
quote: isn't that exactly the opposite of that the PR aims to do?

principle: Add new fields and messages at the end of log structures to preserve existing replay logs.
quote: please add to end of list, not middle, to preserve existing replay logs

principle: Authors should read and respond to review comments personally rather than with AI replies.
quote: non-AI reply preferred, would you mind reading this youself?

principle: Change the consumer rather than the estimator when the output is only used by one consumer, and make terrain-based influence one-way (can disable protections but not trigger them).
quote: I think we shouldn't be changing the EKF here and instead just change AP_GroundEffect, but make it a one-way change

principle: Hardware quirks should be fixed in the HAL, not worked around in higher-level libraries in a way that breaks other users such as scripting GPIO.
quote: this needs to be fixed in the HAL if this is an issue on the RP2350. this would break GPIO in scripting combined with relays

principle: Do not add special-case interfaces for one caller such as Lua; keep behaviour consistent with other callers and keep changes EKF-internal to avoid AP_DAL interface changes.
quote: why is lua special and different from R/C switching? if we can change lua as well then that avoids the interface/AP_DAL issue

principle: Changes should get an automated AP-Review pass before merge.
quote: I'd like to see an @AP-Review review, apart from that looks good, thanks!
